blockers.summary: Whitepaper canonical pragmatics requires type and permits a distinct speech_act; current schema/runtime instead require act and omit core speech_act. The canonical field model and migration semantics must be reconciled Whitepaper-first.

Whitepaper v0.1 defines ordered requested permission modes RO/SUGGEST/PREVIEW/RW/EXEC/COMMIT plus scope/forbids/limits/confirmation/review/logging. Current candidate wire model replaced this with capability/resource arrays and non-ordered profiles. Host capability intersection may be retained internally, but the wire contract must be restored or the Whitepaper explicitly revised.

Whitepaper canonical Lattice includes ordered Octad atomic/framed/named/stream forms. Current grammar defines only the compact operator carrier. Canonical grammar and compact-to-canonical mapping are incomplete.

Whitepaper context surface includes parent packet identity plus timezone/window concepts; current candidate field names/shape differ. Exact Whitepaper field semantics must be reconciled without silent aliases.

Authorization references, expiry, delegation metadata and typed resource/capability structures are useful implementation/security additions but are not all established as Whitepaper v0.1 core fields. Their core-vs-extension/revision status must be resolved.

Existing parser/compiler/canonicalization/authorization/replay tests are substantial, but the conformance corpus must be rebuilt/expanded against the restored Whitepaper-first contract, including canonical packet forms and migration vectors.

Systematic adversarial/property/fuzz coverage remains incomplete after the contract repair, especially permission preservation, compact-to-canonical equivalence, malformed canonical Lattice and migration ambiguity.
No independent second implementation has passed the Whitepaper-reconciled shared vectors or reproduced canonical bytes/semantics.
Whitepaper publication synchronization, source figures and reproducible publication build remain incomplete; the current PDF remains Level 1 during reconciliation.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented against a frozen Whitepaper-reconciled contract.
Final clean CI evidence, migration policy, compatibility evidence, release audit and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
